description: Command-R-style grounded template with a `{% if documents %}` block iterating `document.doc_id` / `document.title` / `document.text` — exercises the #1967 RAG documents threading. Before #1967 the renderer hard-coded `documents: []`, so this block never fired.

messages.text: What is the capital of France?

documents.title: France
documents.text: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France.

documents.title: Geography
documents.text: France is a country in Western Europe.
